scope: Primary inputs for a project-derived stable ramification/Hodge comparison, its CM-height specialization and rational analytic bounds.

sources.title: Qing Liu and Dino Lorenzini, Models of curves and finite covers
sources.use: Extension of generic finite maps between stable models, without requiring the extended morphism to remain finite. The differential and second ramification map are derived in the project report.
sources.restriction: Minimal regular models are not asserted functorial.

sources.title: Xinyi Yuan and Shou-Wu Zhang, On the averaged Colmez conjecture
sources.use: Averaged CM height, nearby-type identity, and the canonical arithmetic Hodge system with local dualizing normalization at sufficiently small levels.
sources.normalization: CM Faltings heights divide degree by [K:Q]; the paper's Shimura-point height divides by [K:F]. D104 uses absolute heights throughout.
sources.excluded_results: CM-point Theorems 1.6 and 1.7 exclude common finite ramification and are not applied. Their exclusion does not restrict structural Theorems 4.5 and 4.7.

sources.title: Roy Zhao, Heights of Special Points on Quaternionic Shimura Varieties
locations: Sections 6-7: Hodge system, metrics and Kodaira-Spencer comparison
Theorem 7.4 and statement of Theorem 7.5, page 25
Last display in proof of Theorem 7.5, page 27
sources.use: Theorem 7.4 applies at maximal level with common CM/quaternion ramification. Combining it with the published nearby and averaged identities yields h_L=-R/8+log(2)/16.
sources.discrepancy: The final proof display of 7.5 omits d_Sigma from log(d_B*d_Sigma), unlike 7.4 and the statements of 1.1/7.5. D104 retains the factor and derives its specialization from 7.4. No author confirmation is claimed.
sources.normalization: Absolute height; ||d_tau||=2*Im(tau). CM Faltings squared norm uses (2*pi)^(-8), separately from D103's curve metric.

sources.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions
sources.use: Dirichlet L/Hurwitz identities, special Hurwitz values, the Gamma integral, and log-Gamma series. Project calculations supply explicit rational remainders for two independent enclosures.

project_deductions: Integral differential on nodal models, then its derivative at simple ramification
Stable CM fibre height <= 2*absolute Hodge height+log(2), via auxiliary small levels
Exact conductor-64 character traces and h_L<17/10
Candidate-only height<683 and conditional one/all-embedding error thresholds
